channel.title: Violations Watch: Nigeria
channel.description: New incidents reported in Nigeria. Most entries are unverified leads, not findings.

item.title: Bandits attack a Sokoto State community: three killed per police (four per residents) and several women abducted
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Sokoto, Nigeria. Types: Killing of civilians, Abduction & hostage-taking. Alleged perpetrator: Bandits. Reported casualties: 3-4 killed. Disputed or caveats: Police say three killed, residents four; number abducted unclear. 5 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0749

item.title: Police in Zamfara report rescuing 19 women and children held for 22 days by bandits after their abduction from Tungar Haki village, Gusau
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Tungar Haki village, Gusau, Zamfara, Nigeria. Types: Abduction & hostage-taking. Alleged perpetrator: Bandits. Grave violations against children: Abduction. Disputed or caveats: Police account. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0865

item.title: Suspected bandits attack a mosque during dawn prayers in Kaura town, Kaura Namoda LGA, Zamfara: one worshipper killed and several abducted (media reports)
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Kaura Namoda, Zamfara, Nigeria. Types: Killing of civilians, Abduction & hostage-taking. Alleged perpetrator: Suspected bandits. Reported casualties: 1 killed. Disputed or caveats: Grouped with other Zamfara posts (a rescue of abducted women and children; a separate report of four killed) that may be distinct events; casualty figure from initial reports. 8 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0711
